title: A Sharp Spectral Erdős--Ko--Rado Theorem for Uniform Hypergraphs
summary: The spectral Erdős--Ko--Rado problem asks for the largest adjacency-tensor spectral radius of a $t$-intersecting $k$-uniform family. Keevash, Lenz and Mubayi proved that, for fixed $k,t$ and sufficiently large $n$, the unique extremal family is a full $t$-star, and asked whether such a theorem extends to all $n$. Let $\mathcal{A}_r=\{F\in\binom{[n]}k:|F\cap[t+2r]|\ge t+r\}$ be the Frankl families and write $ρ_r$ for their spectral radii.
